subject.title: fix(reply): surface block-reply coalescer buffered-tail discard after abort

question: Should this log-only PR be allowed to close the linked Telegram message-loss issue, or should it land only as observability until real Telegram/gateway proof shows the final fallback re-delivers the complete reply?
rationale: Source supports the narrowed abort-discard analysis, but the reporter observed visible loss and the PR body explicitly says no live Telegram DM proof was run.

options.title: Require proof before issue closure
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a live run showing the abort discard diagnostic and complete final fallback before treating this as the closing fix.

options.title: Land as observability only
options.body: Merge the log/test improvement but remove or override the closing linkage so the message-loss issue remains open for delivery proof.

options.title: Expand into delivery repair
options.body: Have the branch prove and fix the actual Telegram tail-loss path instead of only surfacing the abort discard.

recommendation.title: Require proof before issue closure
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a live run showing the abort discard diagnostic and complete final fallback before treating this as the closing fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history put the shared coalescer, pipeline abort state, and final fallback comments closest to this person.
